how.title: From your voice to your website
how.sub: Three steps. No forms to fill, no templates to learn.
how.speak.title: Speak about your business
how.speak.text: Say what you sell, where, and how customers reach you, in any of 9 Indian languages. Add a few photos.
trust.title: Responsible by design
trust.sub: The agent acts, the owner stays in control. Every rule below is enforced in code, not just in the prompt.
trust.approve.title: You approve first
trust.approve.text: The server refuses to publish until the owner presses Approve. Any change needs a new approval.
trust.payments.title: Honest payments
trust.payments.text: Orders stay "pending" until the owner confirms the money arrived. A QR code is never treated as payment.
trust.totals.title: Server-side totals
trust.totals.text: Totals come from the store's saved prices. Prices sent by a browser are ignored.
trust.key.title: Your store, your key
trust.key.text: Only the owner's session or private manage link can edit the store or see orders. Customer text can't command the agent.
footer.tagline: Lakshmi didn't learn to build a website. She just spoke.

how.build.title: AI builds your website
how.build.text: It writes your content in two languages, turns photos into a catalogue and picks a style that suits your business.
how.publish.title: Customize and publish
how.publish.text: Check the phone preview, change anything by voice, then tap Approve. Your site goes live on its own secure address.
features.title: Everything a small business needs online
features.sub: Made for owners who would rather talk than type.
features.voice.title: Voice-first creation
features.voice.text: Describe your business out loud. The words appear on screen so you can fix them before sending.
features.languages.title: Your language, everywhere
features.languages.text: Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati and English, from the first screen to your order emails.
features.content.title: Content written for you
features.content.text: Headlines, product descriptions and FAQs in two languages, written from what you said and your photos.
features.edit.title: Change it by voice
features.edit.text: “Make it look premium”, “add Sunday special biryani ₹180” or “undo that”. Only what you ask for changes.
features.mobile.title: Made for phones
features.mobile.text: Every website works on any phone, with a cart, UPI payment and a WhatsApp button.
features.publish.title: Live in one tap
features.publish.text: Your own web address with HTTPS, a QR code for your shop counter and new orders by email.
